nodes.description: Private mapping tracking token balance of each address in ERC20
Private nested mapping tracking allowance of spender for each owner
Private uint256 holding total token supply
Corra constructor that mints 10000000 * 10**decimals() tokens to msg.sender
Internal ERC20 mint that increases _totalSupply and recipient balance
Internal ERC20 transfer that debits sender and credits recipient balances
Public ERC20 transferFrom that spends and decrements an allowance
Public ERC20Burnable burn that destroys caller tokens via _burn
Public ERC20Burnable burnFrom that spends allowance and burns account tokens
Internal ERC20 burn that reduces account balance and total supply
Internal ERC20 allowance setter writing to _allowances
Public allowance increase using addition on stored allowance
Public allowance decrease using checked subtraction on stored allowance
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender and used as minter, burner and spender
Integer addition _totalSupply += amount inside _mint
Integer addition _balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer
Integer subtraction _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount inside _transfer
Integer subtraction currentAllowance - amount passed to _approve in transferFrom
Integer subtraction _totalSupply -= amount inside _burn
Integer subtraction _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount inside _burn
Integer addition _allowances[msg.sender][spender] + addedValue in increaseAllowance
Integer subtraction currentAllowance - subtractedValue in decreaseAllowance

edges.reason: Constructor passes msg.sender as the recipient of the initial _mint call
burn uses _msgSender() as the account whose tokens are destroyed, so the caller controls the burned account
burnFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is consumed
transferFrom uses _msgSender() to look up and decrement the caller allowance
msg.sender is forwarded into _mint as the account receiving newly minted supply
burn amount parameter flows into the burn routine
burnFrom account parameter is used for allowance lookup and burning
burnFrom amount parameter is compared with allowance and burned
burnFrom amount is subtracted from currentAllowance before re-approval
_transfer sender parameter drives balance lookup and debit
_transfer recipient parameter drives balance credit
_transfer amount parameter flows into the transfer logic
_transfer amount is added to the recipient balance
_transfer amount is subtracted from the sender balance
senderBalance local variable is the minuend of the sender balance subtraction
transferFrom sender parameter selects the allowance and source balance
transferFrom recipient parameter receives the transferred tokens
transferFrom amount parameter is validated against the allowance
transferFrom amount is subtracted from currentAllowance
currentAllowance local variable is the minuend of the allowance subtraction
_mint account parameter receives the minted balance
_mint amount parameter is added to balance and total supply
_mint amount is added to _totalSupply
increaseAllowance spender parameter identifies the allowance slot
increaseAllowance addedValue parameter is added to the stored allowance
addedValue is the addend of the allowance addition
decreaseAllowance spender parameter identifies the allowance slot
decreaseAllowance subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the stored allowance
subtractedValue is the subtrahend of the allowance subtraction
accountBalance local variable is the minuend of the burn balance subtraction
Constructor executes _mint to create the initial supply
burn delegates to _burn with _msgSender() and amount
burnFrom delegates to _burn after allowance adjustment
burnFrom calls _approve to decrement the caller allowance
transferFrom executes _transfer to move the tokens
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spent allowance
_transfer executes the recipient balance addition
_transfer executes the sender balance subtraction
_mint executes the total supply addition
_burn executes the total supply subtraction
_burn executes the account balance subtraction
increaseAllowance executes the allowance addition
decreaseAllowance executes the allowance subtraction
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before updating balances, enabling reentrant external logic on a derived contract
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before crediting balance and supply
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before debiting balance and supply
